: *What is LLMesh and what are its main capabilities?* Root node:
An LLM starts from a seed query and BFS-expands related concepts. Each node is a
TRACE_SPAN; breadth drives an SPC alarm so we can detect "runaway" exploration. The final tree renders as an ASCII
